definition: The work done to assemble a system of charges by bringing them from infinite separation; for two point charges $E_\text{p} = k\frac{q_1 q_2}{r}$, positive for like charges and negative for unlike charges.
The work needed per coulomb to move a small positive test charge from infinity to a point, zero at infinity; a scalar measured in volts, $V_\text{e} = \frac{kQ}{r}$ for a point charge.
